title: Reset Password
content: Users can reset their password from the Settings > Security panel. If you have forgotten your password and cannot log in, click on the 'Forgot Password' link on the login page. Enter your registered email address and you will receive a password reset link. The reset link is valid for 24 hours. For security reasons, your new password must be at least 12 characters long and contain at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one number, and one special character.

title: VPN Setup Guide
content: To access internal company resources remotely, you must use the Corporate Secure VPN. First, download the GlobalProtect VPN client from the Software Center or self-service portal. Once installed, launch the application and enter 'vpn.company.com' as the portal address. Log in using your standard corporate single sign-on (SSO) credentials. You will be prompted to approve a Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) request on your Duo Mobile app. Always disconnect from the VPN when you are finished working.

title: Remote Work and Office Policy
content: Our company operates under a hybrid work model. Employees are expected to work from their designated local office at least three days per week (typically Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday), with the option to work remotely on Mondays and Fridays. Core collaboration hours are between 10:00 AM and 3:00 PM local time. If you need to work fully remotely for an extended period, you must submit a formal request via the Workday HR portal and obtain written approval from your manager and department head.

title: HR and Benefits Contacts
content: For inquiries regarding health benefits, dental insurance, and vision plans, contact the HR Benefits Team at benefits@company.com or call extension 4500. For payroll questions, direct deposit setup, or tax forms, reach out to payroll@company.com. General human resources queries should be sent to hr-support@company.com. The HR department is located on the 4th floor of the main building, and walk-in hours are Monday through Thursday from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM.

title: Expense Reimbursement Policy
content: Business-related expenses must be submitted for reimbursement through the Concur Expense platform within 30 days of the transaction. All expenses exceeding $25 require an itemized receipt. Travel expenses, including flights and lodging, must be booked through the company's preferred travel agency, Egencia. Meals are reimbursed up to a daily limit of $75. Alcohol is not reimbursable. Claims submitted after 60 days will be automatically rejected unless accompanied by written exception approval from the CFO.

title: Holiday Schedule 2026
content: The company observes the following paid holidays for the calendar year 2026: New Year's Day (January 1), Memorial Day (May 25), Juneteenth (June 19), Independence Day (July 4, observed July 3), Labor Day (September 7), Thanksgiving Day (November 26), Day after Thanksgiving (November 27), and Christmas Day (December 25). In addition, employees receive two floating holidays to be used at their discretion, subject to manager approval.

title: IT Equipment Request
content: Standard IT equipment including laptops, monitors, keyboards, mice, and docking stations are provided to all new hires. If you require a replacement or an upgrade, submit a ticket in the Jira Service Management portal under the 'IT Equipment Request' category. Monitors can be requested up to a maximum of two 27-inch displays. Ergonomic chairs or standing desks require a doctor's recommendation or approval from the Facilities team.
